WITH per AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('TY','2026-08-03'::DATE,'2026-08-30'::DATE),('LY','2025-07-28'::DATE,'2025-08-24'::DATE)) t(p,s,e)),
f AS (
 SELECT per.p, st.store_id, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) nd, sum(f.net_amount) net_all,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code<>'ST' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) nonst, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days_with_sales
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT per.p, store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nb, sum(returns_net) rn, sum(net_sales) ns, count(*) rdays FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN per ON r.business_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT coalesce(f.store_id,r.store_id) store_id, coalesce(f.p,r.p) p, f.n, f.nd, f.net_all, f.staff_net, f.nonst, f.days_with_sales, r.nb, r.rn, r.ns, r.rdays
FROM f FULL JOIN r ON f.p=r.p AND f.store_id=r.store_id ORDER BY 1,2

WITH per AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('TY','2026-08-03'::DATE,'2026-08-30'::DATE),('LY','2025-07-28'::DATE,'2025-08-24'::DATE)) t(p,s,e)),
dup AS (SELECT per.p, count(*) dup_groups, sum(c-1) extra_lines FROM (SELECT sale_date, receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>1) x JOIN per ON x.sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (SELECT per.p, st.store_id<900 AS physical, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT return_line_id) nd, sum(refund_net) refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key GROUP BY 1,2),
rp AS (SELECT per.p, sum(returns_net) rpt_returns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN per ON r.business_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e WHERE store_id<900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'dup' k, p, dup_groups::DOUBLE a, extra_lines::DOUBLE b, NULL::BOOLEAN c FROM dup
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret', p, n::DOUBLE, refund_net::DOUBLE, physical FROM ret
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt', p, rpt_returns::DOUBLE, NULL, NULL FROM rp

calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT store_id, open_date, close_date FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900
),
lfl AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM s
  WHERE close_date IS NULL
    AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2024-07-28')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT r.store_id,
    sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN r.net_sales END) AS ty,
    sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' THEN r.net_sales END) AS ly
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
  WHERE r.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
  count(*) AS n_stores,
  round(sum(ty),2) AS ty, round(sum(ly),2) AS ly,
  round((sum(ty)/sum(ly)-1)*100,2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
  round((sum(CASE WHEN store_id<>125 THEN ty END)/sum(CASE WHEN store_id<>125 THEN ly END)-1)*100,2) AS ex125_pct,
  round((sum(ty)+13252.52+0)/1 ,2) AS dummy
FROM sales JOIN lfl USING (store_id)

calls.statement:
WITH lfl AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM dim_store
  WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND close_date IS NULL
    AND (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= DATE '2024-07-28')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT store_id,
    sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' THEN net_sales END) AS this_year,
    sum(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' THEN net_sales END) AS last_year
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
  round((sum(this_year) / sum(last_year) - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct
FROM sales JOIN lfl USING (store_id)
